purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Rafiganj

queries.query: Rafiganj Bihar official cadastral parcel map land records GIS Bihar Bhunaksha
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Government of Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms land-record services and the official Bihar BhuNaksha cadastral map viewer. The official viewer documents district/subdivision/circle/mauza selection and a public map backend.

queries.query: रफीगंज बिहार सरकारी भू नक्शा जमीन रिकॉर्ड खसरा
queries.result: Hindi-language discovery identified the Government of Bihar BiharBhumi portal and its भू-मानचित्र service, plus the official BhuNaksha Bihar viewer. The first-party viewer's live location API enumerated Aurangabad district and Rafiganj circle using English and Hindi labels.

registryEvidence.custodian: Directorate of Land Records & Survey / Revenue and Land Reforms Department, Government of Bihar; Bihar BhuNaksha public cadastral map service
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The official BhuNaksha service exposed Aurangabad district code 34, subdivision code 01, and Rafiganj circle code 06. This evidences a local cadastral-map service, not complete municipal or citywide parcel coverage.

officialSources.observation: Current first-party Bihar BhuNaksha landing page states that the service is cadastral mapping software for digitized cadastral maps and links to the map viewer.
Current first-party viewer HTML loads config.js and index.js; the UI exposes district, sub-division, circle, mauza, survey type, map instance, sheet, and plot selection.
Government of Bihar portal identifies Bihar land-record services, including भू-मानचित्र (land map).
Government of Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms Department describes responsibility for land records, survey, settlement, and maintenance of rights records.
